<reason>A won a close, high-quality debate by occupying “broadly free,” making funding a live mechanism fight, and weighing partial visible commercialization against total quiet closure. B was more memorable on civic belonging and second rent, but after A rejected ticketed sand B kept punching fenced-water images and never showed why a refuseable deck/rink is worse than the edge cafe B already allowed, or how “restore the crew” survives the budget politics A made central.</reason>
